name: Calah
meaning: Ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod
notes: Calah was an ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod, along with Nineveh and Resen.

name: Caleb_Ephrathah
meaning: Place associated with Hezron's death
notes: Caleb Ephrathah was the place where Hezron, the son of Perez, died.

name: Calneh
meaning: Ancient Mesopotamian city, possibly Kullania or Kullanhu
notes: Calneh (Calno) was an ancient city in Mesopotamia, mentioned as one of Nimrod's cities and later as a trading partner of Tyre.

name: Canaan
meaning: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants
notes: Canaan was the ancient region between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea, named after Noah's grandson and later promised to Abraham's descendants.

name: Capernaum
meaning: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry
notes: Capernaum was a fishing village on the Sea of Galilee that served as a center for Jesus' ministry in the region.

name: Caphtor
meaning: Island home of the Philistines; visited by Paul
notes: Caphtor, identified as the island of Crete, was the original homeland of the Philistines and a place visited by the apostle Paul.

name: Cappadocia
meaning: Region in Asia Minor; home to early Christian believers
notes: Cappadocia was a region in Asia Minor where some early Christian believers lived.

name: Carchemish
meaning: Ancient city; site of Babylonian victory over Egypt
notes: Carchemish was an ancient city on the Euphrates River where the Babylonians decisively defeated the Egyptians.

name: Carmel
meaning: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail
notes: Carmel was a town in Judah, known as the home of Nabal and his wife Abigail, who later married David.

name: Carmel_Mount
meaning: Mountain range; site of Elijah's confrontation with prophets of Baal
notes: Mount Carmel was a mountain range in northern Israel where the prophet Elijah confronted the prophets of Baal.

name: Casiphia
meaning: Place where Levites were recruited for temple service
notes: Casiphia was a place in Babylon where Ezra sent for Levites to join the returning exiles in Jerusalem.

name: Cauda
meaning: Island where Paul's ship sought shelter
notes: Cauda was an island where the ship carrying Paul sought shelter during a storm on his journey to Rome.

name: Cenchreae
meaning: Port of Corinth; home of Phoebe
notes: Cenchreae was the eastern port of Corinth, where Paul had his hair cut in connection with a vow, and was the home of Phoebe, a deaconess of the church.

name: Chaldea
meaning: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom
notes: Chaldea was an ancient Mesopotamian empire, known for its astrologers and wise men, that played a significant role in the history of Israel, particularly during the Babylonian exile.

name: Chebar
meaning: River in Babylonia; location of Ezekiel's visions
notes: The Chebar River was a waterway in Babylonia near which the prophet Ezekiel received visions from God during the Babylonian exile.

name: Chephar-ammoni
meaning: Town in Benjamin's territory
notes: Chephar-ammoni was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Chephirah
meaning: Gibeonite town; later part of Benjamin and Judah
notes: Chephirah was one of the Gibeonite towns that became part of the territories of Benjamin and Judah.

name: Cherith
meaning: Brook where Elijah hid during drought
notes: The Brook Cherith was where the prophet Elijah hid and was fed by ravens during a drought in Israel.

name: Cherub
meaning: Babylonian location; home of some returning exiles
notes: Cherub was a place in Babylonia from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian captivity.

name: Chesalon
meaning: Landmark on Judah's northern border
notes: Chesalon, also known as Mount Jearim, was a landmark on the northern boundary of Judah, near Bethshemesh.

name: Chesil
meaning: Town in Judah's southern region
notes: Chesil was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the southern part of their territory.

name: Chesulloth
meaning: Border town of Issachar and Zebulun
notes: Chesulloth, also known as Chisloth-tabor or Tabor, was a town on the border between Issachar and Zebulun.

name: Chilmad
meaning: Trading partner of Tyre
notes: Chilmad was a place mentioned by Ezekiel as one of Tyre's trading partners.

name: Chinnereth
meaning: Lake in northern Israel; and the plain on its north west
notes: Chinnereth, also known as the Sea of Galilee or the Sea of Tiberias, is a freshwater lake and the name of the town on its north-west and its surrounding plain

name: Chios
meaning: Island visited by Paul on his journey
notes: Chios was an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul's ship stopped during his journey to Jerusalem.

name: Chitlish
meaning: Town in Judah's Shephelah region
notes: Chitlish was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the Shephelah region.

name: Chorazin
meaning: Town in Galilee; rebuked by Jesus for unbelief
notes: Chorazin was a town in Galilee that Jesus rebuked for its lack of repentance despite the mighty works he had done there.

name: Cilicia
meaning: Province in Asia Minor; Paul's birthplace and ministry area
notes: Cilicia, a province in southeast Asia Minor, was the birthplace of Paul and an area where he ministered to the early churches.

name: City_of_Salt
meaning: Town in the wilderness of Judah
notes: The City of Salt was a town located in the wilderness of Judah, near the Dead Sea.

name: Cnidus
meaning: City on the coast of Asia Minor
notes: Cnidus was a city on the southwest coast of Asia Minor, where Paul's ship stopped during his journey to Rome.

name: Colossae
meaning: City in Phrygia; recipient of Paul's epistle
notes: Colossae was a city in the region of Phrygia in Asia Minor, to which Paul addressed one of his epistles.

name: Corban
meaning: Offering dedicated to God; temple treasury
notes: Corban refers to an offering dedicated to God, which the Pharisees used to avoid supporting their parents, and also to the temple treasury.

name: Corinth
meaning: Ancient Greek city; recipient of Paul's epistles
notes: Corinth, an important city in ancient Greece, was the location of a Christian church to which Paul wrote two epistles.

name: Corner_Gate
meaning: Fortified gate in Jerusalem's wall
notes: The Corner Gate was a fortified gate in Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in connection with repairs and measurements of the city.

name: Cos
meaning: Island visited by Paul on his journey
notes: Cos was an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul's ship stopped during his return journey to Jerusalem.

name: Cush
meaning: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon
notes: Cush, often translated as Ethiopia, was an ancient region in Africa, mentioned in various contexts throughout the Bible.

name: Cushan
meaning: Unknown location, possibly related to Cush
notes: Cushan, a location mentioned in Habakkuk 3:7 , is possibly related to Cush or another unidentified place.

name: Cuthah
meaning: Babylonian city; origin of Samaritan settlers
notes: Cuthah was a Babylonian city from which the Assyrian king brought people to settle in Samaria after the deportation of the Israelites.

name: Cyprus
meaning: Island in the Mediterranean Sea; early Christian community
notes: Cyprus, also referred to as Kittim and Elishah, was an island in the Mediterranean Sea that played a significant role in the spread of early Christianity.

name: Cyrene
meaning: City in North Africa; home of early Christians
notes: Cyrene, a city in North Africa, was the hometown of Simon, who carried Jesus' cross, and several early Christians mentioned in Acts.

name: Dabbesheth
meaning: Border town of Zebulun
notes: Dabbesheth was a town on the border of the territory allocated to the tribe of Zebulun.

name: Daberath
meaning: Levitical city in Issachar's territory
notes: Daberath was a Levitical city located in the territory of Issachar, later given to the Levites of the Gershonite clan.

name: Dalmatia
meaning: Region on the eastern coast of the Adriatic Sea.
notes: Dalmatia, a region in Illyricum where Titus traveled ( 2Ti.4.10 ).

name: Damascus
meaning: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.
notes: Damascus, an ancient city in Syria, played a significant role in biblical history.

name: Dan
meaning: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.
notes: Dan, an Israelite tribe and a city in northern Israel, formerly called Laish or Leshem.

name: Dannah
meaning: A city in the hill country of Judah.
notes: Dannah, a city located in the hill country of Judah ( Joshua 15:49 ).

name: Debir
meaning: Canaanite city captured by Joshua and Caleb's family.
notes: Debir, also known as Kiriath-sannah or Kiriath-sepher, was a Canaanite city captured by Joshua and later by Caleb's family.

name: Debir
meaning: A place on the northern border of Judah.
notes: Debir, a place on the northern border of Judah, distinct from the city of Debir ( Joshua 15:7 ).

name: Decapolis
meaning: A group of ten Hellenistic cities in ancient Palestine.
notes: The Decapolis was a group of ten Hellenistic cities located in ancient Palestine, mentioned in the New Testament.

name: Dedan
meaning: An Arabian people and region, involved in trade.
notes: Dedan was an Arabian people and region, known for their involvement in trade.

name: Derbe
meaning: City in Lycaonia visited by Paul on missionary journeys.
notes: Derbe, a city in Lycaonia, was visited by Paul during his missionary journeys.
